NAIP time series 2009 to 2020: prairie pothole farmland, North Dakota

10 images · bands R=1, G=2, B=3, NIR=4 · water rule: nir · aligned to m_4709963_se_14_1_20090818.tif (EPSG:26914, 5 m pixels) · zones 200 m

Ten 4 band NAIP acquisitions (USDA, public domain) of one quarter quad, resampled to 5 m. Values are 8 bit digital numbers, not calibrated reflectance, so the indices are relative: compare dates from the same part of the season, and treat differences between years as a mix of real change and differences between NAIP collections.
